$schema_note: Objective, user-approved Silver Bullet rules. User rules outrank repository assumptions. Governing doc: docs/SILVER_BULLET_MASTER_INSTRUCTION.md

rules.rule: Reference range = the completed 09:00-10:00 America/New_York H1 candle, built from validated intraday bars, locked at 10:00 NY, never repainted.
Entries only between 10:00 and 11:00 NY, and the entry must FILL before 11:00 - a signal before the deadline with a fill after it is NO_TRADE/LATE.

Mandatory sequence: sweep of one reference side -> failure to accept outside -> reclaim -> displacement -> MSS or CISD -> valid entry array -> stop at sweep extreme + buffer -> target toward the opposite side with acceptable R:R. Any missing mandatory piece = NO_TRADE.
Break-and-acceptance outside the range (multiple closes outside, no reclaim) rejects the reversal setup (BREAK_ACCEPTED_OUTSIDE). Both sides swept before entry rejects by default.
HTF bias mode is BIAS_SCORED: agreement adds score, conflict subtracts and is displayed; it never silently blocks the mechanical trigger.

Silver Bullet setups use setup_family ICT_SILVER_BULLET with their own labels, lifecycle, logs (namespace SILVER_BULLET_SETUP), UI section and statistics - never mixed into CRT or CRT_SESSION families.

Initial parameter values come from the reference backtest and stay configurable: displacement body/range 0.70, body vs ATR 1.5x, FVG min 0.3xATR, min R:R 2.5, BE at 3R, stop buffer 0.25xATR, one filled trade per symbol per day.
